name: Coloured section headings
description: Restyle `\section` and `\subsection`: a coloured heading with a thin rule underneath.
notes: `\titleformat{cmd}{format}{label}{sep}{before-code}[after-code]`. The rule goes in the optional last argument.
`\titlespacing*{\section}{left}{before}{after}`. The `*` removes the indent of the paragraph that follows.
Change `headingblue` once and every heading follows.
